sentences.text:
This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 26.09.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge, Rohini, New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 128/2021 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No. 12/2005-06/DC/(NW) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.
2.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Rohini, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The following relief has been sought by the appellant:

"It is therefore most respectfully prayed to YOUR LORDSHIPS that the appeal may kindly be accepted and the market value of the land of the appellant be further enhanced by Rs. 50 000/ per bigha besides other statutory benefits as admissible under Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as amended up to date, be passed in favour This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/12/2023 at 22:39:24 of the Appellant and against the respondents and the appellant be further granted additional amount as provided under section 23 (I A) and Solatium as provided under section 23(2) and interest on the said sums as per the judgment of Sunder's case be modifying the order judgment & order dated 26.09.2023, passed by the Learned lower court of Sh. Deepak Dabas, ADJ, Rohini,
Delhi in the case bearing LAC No. 128/21 titled as "Bhagwan Singh Versus Union of India & Anr.

sentences.text: Cost of the appeal be also awarded in favour of the humble Appellant."

3. Learned counsel for appellant further states that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in LA APP No. 138/2018 titled Chander Bhan (deceased) through LRs v. Union of India, which was admitted on 13.08.2018 and is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters' for adjudication.
4. Issue notice.

Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Pathak, learned Standing Counsel for R-1/UOI Mr.
Ashim Vachher, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent No.2/DDA.

5. Admit.
6.
List the present appeal in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' along with in LA APP No. 138/2018 titled Chander Bhan (deceased) through LRs v. Union of India.
7. In the meantime, LCR be requisitioned and be tagged along with this appeal.

Also, a digital copy of the same be supplied to the learned counsel for the parties, if so requested.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J DECEMBER 12, 2023/
